results.title: Changed Forever
results.overview: CHANGED FOREVER tells the raw and inspiring true story of Alexis, a woman consumed by the darkness of addiction, teetering on the brink of self-destruction. Her life is a whirlwind of bad choices and devastating consequences, leaving her isolated and hopeless. Just when she believes all is lost, a flicker of faith ignites within her. Driven by desperation, her unwavering faith culminates in a profound, life-altering encounter with God, an experience that shatters her old life and rebuilds her from the ground up. CHANGED FOREVER follows Alexis's arduous journey to sobriety, healing, and ultimately, redemption. More than just a story of overcoming addiction, CHANGED FOREVER is a testament to the transformative power of faith and prayer, offering a beacon of hope to anyone struggling to find their own new beginning.

results.title: NOSEBLEED
results.overview: When unresolved trauma resurfaces, the restless Maya is forced to confront her spiraling nature, both that of victim and that of perpetrator.  NOSEBLEED is a raw, semi-autobiographical dance film in which the border between reality and fiction blurs in a provocative exploration of desire and power.

results.title: Bugambilia
results.overview: Four years of voluntary isolation have turned Emiliano’s home into both a refuge and a sentence. Behind a screen, he finds in Silvya the only closeness he allows himself—until she decides to cross the distance and show up at his door. Confronted with his fear of love and a grief he never came to terms with, Emiliano must decide whether to finally open that door or let the past keep winning.

results.title: Nuestra Próxima Edición
results.overview: “‘Nuestra Próxima Edición ’” tells the story of how a newspaper born in Ponce became the memory of the nation. Print was the vehicle for that story for generations, and we honor it. It is also the story of a commitment to serve Puerto Rico, to provide oversight, and to be present when it matters most. That commitment has driven us to evolve time and again, and today it enables us to reach more Puerto Ricans than ever before. This is the next edition of that story.

results.title: Ride of a Lifetime
results.overview: Ride of a Lifetime follows Þórgunnur Þórarinsdóttir, a young horsewoman from northern Iceland whose life has always revolved around Icelandic horses. Filmed over five years, the documentary follows her journey from an unknown fifteen-year-old rider in rural Skagafjörður to representing Iceland at the 2025 World Championships for Icelandic Horses in Switzerland with her beloved horse, Djarfur frá Flatatungu.
